question: After the final-head macOS Swift lane passes, must this update also pass signed packaged-app smoke for Sparkle updater activation and Peekaboo bridge/computer-action startup?
rationale: The updated packages are production-linked, while the relevant updater and automation paths depend on signing and macOS permissions that compilation and unsigned runs cannot fully settle.

options.title: Require packaged smoke
options.body: Verify updater activation and representative Peekaboo bridge/computer-action startup in a correctly signed packaged app before merge.

options.title: Accept exact-head CI
options.body: Merge after final-head macOS and security checks pass while explicitly accepting the residual packaged-runtime uncertainty.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Validate Sparkle and Peekaboo in separate PRs if isolated proof and rollback are preferred.

recommendation.title: Require packaged smoke
recommendation.body: Verify updater activation and representative Peekaboo bridge/computer-action startup in a correctly signed packaged app before merge.
